title: Managed Database: credit cap fraction
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database credit cap fraction is specified by contracted tier. Maximum cumulative outage credit fraction of the source charge net service subtotal; decimal.

| Contracted tier | Credit cap fraction |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 0.3 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 0.3 |

## Tier comparison
For credit cap fraction, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 0.3.
